title: Trader's license renewal
summary: Businesses that sell goods or merchandise in Maryland, retail or wholesale, need a trader's license from the Clerk of the Circuit Court in their county. The license year runs May 1 to April 30, and licenses must be renewed by May 1 each year. The fee depends on your inventory value. Late licenses add a 10% penalty plus 2% a month.
action: Renew with your county's Clerk of the Circuit Court by May 1.
filingSiteName: Your county's Clerk of the Circuit Court
sourceName: Comptroller of Maryland: A Guide to Business Licenses (Tip #64)

title: Restaurant license renewal (Clerk of the Circuit Court)
summary: Restaurants need a business license from the Clerk of the Circuit Court. Like other Clerk licenses, the license year runs May 1 to April 30 and must be renewed by May 1 each year.
action: Renew with your county's Clerk of the Circuit Court by May 1.
filingSiteName: Your county's Clerk of the Circuit Court
sourceName: Comptroller of Maryland: A Guide to Business Licenses (Tip #64)

title: Construction firm license renewal (Clerk of the Circuit Court)
summary: Construction businesses need a license from the Clerk of the Circuit Court. The license year runs May 1 to April 30 and must be renewed by May 1 each year.
action: Renew with your county's Clerk of the Circuit Court by May 1.
filingSiteName: Your county's Clerk of the Circuit Court
sourceName: Comptroller of Maryland: A Guide to Business Licenses (Tip #64)

title: Maryland Home Improvement Commission (MHIC) license
summary: Contractors who do home improvement work on residential property need an MHIC license. Licenses renew every two years, with a $175 Guaranty Fund assessment at each renewal.
action: If you do residential home improvement work, keep your MHIC license current and renew before the expiration date on your license.
frequencyNote: By the date on your license

title: Salon permit and cosmetology licenses
summary: Salons need a permit from the Maryland State Board of Cosmetologists, and anyone performing services must hold their own license and work through a licensed salon or barbershop.
action: Renew your salon permit and check staff licenses before they expire.
frequencyNote: By the date on your permit

title: Food service facility license (local health department)
summary: Restaurants and other retail food businesses need an annual food service facility license from the local health department in {{county}}. Mobile units have extra requirements, such as a base of operations.
action: Renew your license with the {{county}} health department each year and keep up with inspections.
frequencyNote: Renewal date set by your county
sourceName: Maryland Department of Health: Food licenses and permits

title: Alcohol license renewal
summary: Retail alcohol licenses are issued, renewed, and enforced by local liquor boards, not the state. Your license comes from the liquor board for {{county}} (the City of Annapolis has its own board). Renewal dates and fees are set locally.
action: Check your license's renewal date with your local liquor board. Find the board in the state's directory.
frequencyNote: Renewal date set by your liquor board
